validation.semantics: Read all 20 es values side by side with the en source and frozen context, and confirmed each render site in team-bridge-emoji-picker.tsx and team-bridge-reactions.tsx. Address form is tú throughout (Inténtalo, Elige), matching the style guide and the locale. Phrasing matches the locale's existing patterns: Añadir … (25 uses, no agregar), Buscar … (Buscar archivos/etiquetas/ajustes), No se pudo/pudieron … Inténtalo de nuevo., Predeterminado, and No se encontraron … (same construction as ui.settings.imports.empty_sessions). toneDefault 'Tono predeterminado' drops 'de piel', which is a sound tightening: the option sits inside a select labelled 'Tono de piel' and the other options are toned glyphs. Sentence case, no '!', no space before punctuation, final period on the one full-sentence value (failed), as in the English. reactions.empty is referenced only in keys.gen.ts and not rendered by the reviewed components; its value matches noResults.
validation.icu: Ran node with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser parse() on all 20 delta values from the catalogue bytes: each parsed to a single literal node with zero arguments, and no {, }, < or > appears. English has no placeholders. All 20 values are NFC (v === v.normalize('NFC')) and contain no U+200E/200F/202A-202E/2066-2069/061C. Key parity is 129/129 en/es, nothing missing or extra. A node comparison against `git show 2e16fb1456:src/i18n/catalogues/es/ui.teamBridge.json` (sha256 83f83edf… verified) found 109/109 base values byte-identical and exactly 20 new keys.
validation.terminology: emoji/emojis is used consistently (singular in 'Elige un emoji', plural elsewhere), matching the CLDR es label 'Emojis'. reacción is used consistently. No glossary §1/§2 terms are involved. Category labels were compared with CLDR 48.2.0 es characterLabels (fetched from the cldr-misc-full package via jsDelivr). Exact matches: Animales y naturaleza, Comida y bebida, Actividades, Objetos, Símbolos, Banderas. CLDR has no separate Smileys & Emotion or People & Body label (it combines them as 'Emoticonos y personas'), so 'Caras y emociones' and 'Personas y cuerpo' are accurate free renderings. CLDR travel_places is 'Viajes y destinos'; 'Viajes y lugares' is the literal, accurate rendering of the Unicode group name and is not a defect.
